section5_markov_analysis.consequence: The enumerator MUST carry (r_count, r1_target_orbit) in its search state, as both the Round 17 raw enumerator and the Round 19 canonical enumerator do. That this universe happens to have zero collisions is a fact about the universe, not a license to drop the fields.
section5_markov_analysis.verdict_deductive: 손증명 that the history field IS required: chaining is defined as (R1 target orbit == R2 source orbit). A post-R2 ExactState is (p, hex_masks, orbit_masks, F, S, H). orbit_masks records WHICH (orbit,phase) pairs are visited but carries no record of WHICH edge was R1. Therefore r1_target_orbit is not a function of the post-R2 state, and chaining cannot be decided from the post-R2 state alone. same-component is likewise computed on the PRE-R2 component map, which the post-R2 state has already modified by merging R2's own target. Both relations are boundary (edge) data, not state data.
section5_markov_analysis.verdict_empirical: VACUOUS -- all 2,234 distinct post-R2 states at depth 6 are reached by exactly ONE R2 boundary, so no two histories can be compared; the check can neither confirm nor refute Markov-completeness.
